summary: Comprehensive multi-domain audit of memorius v0.9.3 (Python memory vault: FastAPI REST API + MCP stdio server + CLI + 3D bookcase UI). Ten domain analysts (security, backend, api, db, dependencies, frontend, infra, testing, design, ui-ux) produced independent markdown reports in dev-notes/teammate-analysis/, cross-referenced in INDEX.md. Total 217 findings: 11 Critical, 50 High, 99 Medium, 45 Low, 2 Info. Dominant cross-cutting risk: weak/absent authentication (REST opt-in API key, MCP zero auth), compounded by path traversal, injection surface, SSRF, XSS, loose dependency pinning with no lockfile, destructive ops without confirmation, no cross-store transactions, and major test/auth/accessibility gaps.

criticalFindings.title: REST server unauthenticated when MEMORIUS_API_KEY unset — all write/delete endpoints open
criticalFindings.description: auth_middleware only enforces the API key when MEMORIUS_API_KEY is set. When unset (the local default), every endpoint including /store, /delete, /prune, /consolidate, /obsidian/export and /obsidian/import is unauthenticated. run_rest_server() warns but starts without auth.
criticalFindings.fix: Require API key by default (fail closed); refuse non-loopback binds without auth; do not treat auth-disabled as informational.

criticalFindings.title: MCP server has zero authentication — any stdio client can invoke delete/prune/consolidate/graph_export
criticalFindings.description: The MCP stdio JSON-RPC server implements no authentication at all; any process that can spawn the CLI gains full vault read/write access across 35+ tools.
criticalFindings.fix: Add authentication to the MCP server (token validation on initialize) or restrict it to trusted local processes at the spawn boundary.

criticalFindings.title: REST endpoints unauthenticated when API key unset; no read/write key distinction
criticalFindings.description: A single key (if set) grants full access to read and mutate operations. There is no read/write scoped key and no authorization layer (no RBAC, no vault-scoped permissions).
criticalFindings.fix: Introduce read/write scoped keys and enforce auth on all mutating endpoints by default; add vault-scoped permissions.

criticalFindings.title: Consolidation mutates memories destructively with no snapshot and dry_run defaults to False
criticalFindings.description: consolidate() merges memories destructively with no snapshot/undo. tool_memorius_consolidate passes dry_run=args.get("dry_run", False), so consolidation mutates data by default; a bad similarity threshold can merge distinct memories irreversibly.
criticalFindings.fix: Make dry_run=True the default for the MCP tool; add a pre-consolidation snapshot (export JSON + vector IDs) restorable on failure; surface a preview of candidate merge pairs before any write.

criticalFindings.title: chromadb loose-pinned >=0.4.22 admits versions with pre-auth RCE / cross-tenant CVEs
criticalFindings.description: ChromaDB has published CVEs (CVE-2026-45829 pre-auth code injection via trust_remote_code; CVE-2026-45831 cross-tenant RBAC bypass). The >=0.4.22 constraint admits vulnerable versions; no lockfile is committed, so reproducible builds are not guaranteed.
criticalFindings.fix: Pin chromadb below the vulnerable range; commit a lockfile; add pip-audit/safety to CI.

criticalFindings.title: No REST authentication bypass tests
criticalFindings.description: No test verifies 401 on missing/invalid Bearer token, or that endpoints are open when the key is unset.
criticalFindings.fix: Add tests that set MEMORIUS_API_KEY and verify /store / /delete / /prune return 401 without a valid Bearer token and 200 with it.

criticalFindings.title: No tests that REST rejects unauthenticated requests when API key is set
criticalFindings.description: The auth middleware exists but is untested for rejection behavior.
criticalFindings.fix: Test that all mutating endpoints return 401 without a valid key when MEMORIUS_API_KEY is set.

criticalFindings.title: No MCP authorization tests — all 35+ tools callable with zero authN/authZ
criticalFindings.description: No tests cover MCP authentication or authorization; every tool is callable by any stdio client.
criticalFindings.fix: Document that MCP requires trusted local processes, or add authentication and test it.

criticalFindings.title: Bookcase usage docs hidden by default; no onboarding CTA for first-time users
criticalFindings.description: The only usage documentation (#bc-usage) is hidden by default with no visible trigger. On an empty vault there is no call-to-action, no link to `memorius store`, and no guided first-memory flow — a first-time user sees an empty library with no indication of how to add anything.
criticalFindings.fix: Reveal an onboarding card on first empty-vault load; add a prominent copyable 'memorius store ...' CTA plus a link to docs/README.

criticalFindings.title: 3D canvas has no ARIA labels / screen-reader support
criticalFindings.description: The 3D library (books, shelves, case labels, tooltip) is rendered entirely into WebGL. Screen readers receive nothing from the canvas — no book labels, shelf names, or position cues — and the visual-only #bc-tooltip is not announced.
criticalFindings.fix: Add aria-label on the canvas plus a visually-hidden aria-live region summarizing current vault/book count and hovered book.

criticalFindings.title: Bookcase API-down error offers no in-UI recovery
criticalFindings.description: The bookcase detects the API is down but offers no Retry, no 'Start REST server' button, and no link to the terminal command — the user is stranded in the 3D view.
criticalFindings.fix: Add Retry plus a copyable 'memorius serve-rest' hint to the error pill.
